headline: Make every part of Aster yours
summary: Canvas has a new layout that puts each wallpaper's Desktop, Lock Screen, and Screen Saver choices in one place. Clips, Shelf, and Bar gain the options you asked for, a new Settings window brings everything together, and a long list of glitches is fixed.

features.title: A clearer Canvas
features.description: Pick a wallpaper and set it for the Desktop, Lock Screen, or Screen Saver from one panel. Shuffle and playback options each have their own tab, and double-clicking a wallpaper sets it right away.

features.title: Every display, every format
features.description: Choose a different wallpaper for each display. GIFs now animate on the Desktop, and motion wallpapers gain speed, dimming, and pause-on-battery controls.

features.title: Clips on your terms
features.description: Set how much history to keep and for how long, ignore any app you choose, and optionally paste a clip the moment you pick it. Pausing capture no longer turns off the Clips shortcut.

features.title: Shelf and Bar, rearranged
features.description: Reorder Shelf widgets, set your own timer lengths, choose its display and hover delay, and get a notification when time is up. Bar can hide icons again after a delay and has a global shortcut.

features.title: New Settings and accent colors
features.description: Turn modules on or off, manage your data, and reset Aster from one window. Pick from nine accent colors for the whole app.
